```{=html}
<section id="contact" class="nw-section">
  <div class="nw-section-inner">
    <div class="nw-contact-card">
      <div class="nw-contact-info">
        <h2>Let's start a conversation</h2>
        <p>I'm always interested in hearing about new projects and opportunities. Whether you're looking to hire, collaborate, or just want to say hi, feel free to reach out!</p>
        <ul class="nw-contact-list">
          <li>
            <span class="nw-contact-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M3 7l9 6l9 -6"/></svg></span>
            <span class="nw-contact-item"><small>Email</small><a href="mailto:noah@noahweidig.com">noah@noahweidig.com</a></span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="nw-contact-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 11a3 3 0 1 0 6 0a3 3 0 0 0 -6 0"/><path d="M17.657 16.657l-4.243 4.243a2 2 0 0 1 -2.827 0l-4.244 -4.243a8 8 0 1 1 11.314 0z"/></svg></span>
            <span class="nw-contact-item"><small>Location</small><span>Orlando, Florida</span></span>
          </li>
          <li>
            <span class="nw-contact-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="7" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 7v-2a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"/><path d="M12 12v.01"/><path d="M3 13a20 20 0 0 0 18 0"/></svg></span>
            <span class="nw-contact-item"><small>Open to</small><span>Data science &amp; GIS roles, collaborations</span></span>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <form class="nw-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/mnjggoke" method="POST" aria-describedby="nw-form-status">
        <div class="nw-field">
          <label for="nw-form-name">Your name</label>
          <input id="nw-form-name" type="text" name="name" placeholder="Jane Doe" autocomplete="name" required>
        </div>
        <div class="nw-field">
          <label for="nw-form-email">Your email</label>
          <input id="nw-form-email" type="email" name="email" placeholder="jane@example.com" autocomplete="email" required>
        </div>
        <div class="nw-field">
          <label for="nw-form-message">Your message</label>
          <textarea id="nw-form-message" name="message" rows="5" placeholder="What you're working on, and how I can help" required></textarea>
        </div>
        <p class="nw-form-status" id="nw-form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" tabindex="-1" hidden></p>
        <div class="nw-btns">
          <button class="nw-btn nw-btn-primary nw-form-submit" type="submit">
            <span class="nw-btn-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            <span class="nw-btn-label">Send Message</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
